name: create_ts_typed_event_bus
description: Creates a generically-typed TS EventBus (on/off/once/emit) consumed by an existing notifier module (cross-file)
prompts: notifier.ts already exists; it does `import { EventBus } from "./event_bus"`, instantiates `new EventBus<AppEvents>()` (where AppEvents maps event names to payload types), and uses bus.on(event, handler), bus.off(event, handler), bus.once(event, handler), and bus.emit(event, payload). Create event_bus.ts exporting a class EventBus<Events extends Record<string, unknown>> whose methods are typed per event: on/off/once take a K extends keyof Events and a handler receiving Events[K]; emit takes the event name and a payload of that event's type. Semantics: emit synchronously calls every handler registered for that event (and nothing for other events, and must not throw when no handler is registered); off removes a previously-registered handler so it no longer fires; once registers a handler that fires for exactly ONE emit and never again. The file must compile under tsc --strict. Do not modify notifier.ts.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit event_bus.ts notifier.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build event_bus.ts notifier.ts
node behavior_test.js
